meta_title: Scrybe — Local subtitles for your own broadcasts
meta_description: Caption any audio source, integrate directly with OBS, customized for your stream. You are in full control. Free, Fully local, open-source, no cloud.

trust_free_body: This means no subscriptions, no cloud latency, no API keys.
trust_privacy_body: Data never leaves your computer. All audio and text processing happens where you have full control over it.
trust_creator_body: There are a handful of good general subtitling programs out there, but none of them are built with creators and streaming in mind.

features_heading: Local subtitles for your own broadcasts.
features_body: Scrybe runs local Speech-To-Text models on your machine to create live captions that you can add to OBS as a browser source.
feat_local_body: All processing happens on your machine. Your audio never leaves your computer. This means no API keys, no cloud latency, no subscriptions.
feat_audio_body: Select any audio device. Caption desktop audio, your voice through your microphone, or even virtual audio cables.
feat_style_body: Scrybe exposes subtitles over an easy to use browser source. Add the overlay URL, adjust text alignment, color, font size, transparency, etc and the overlay will update automatically.
feat_obs_body_post: into OBS and the subtitles appear. Adjust text alignment, color, font size, transparency, etc and the overlay will update automatically.
feat_twitch_body: A dedicated Scrybe OBS plugin that feeds Twitch native captions — viewers turn them on with the player's CC button, no browser source needed.
feat_twitch_footnote: Also through the plugin: microphone mute events.

planned_audio_body: Choose the exact audio source, whether that's a microphone, desktop audio, or audio from a specific process. Follow the system default when it changes, and keep transcription running when it switches.
planned_transcripts_body: More natural caption segments with silence and speaker-aware breaks, steadier updates, accurate timestamps, and speaker identification.
planned_obs_body: A segment-log overlay, saved custom overlay colors, and dedicated OBS plugin support for Twitch native captions and microphone mute events.
tech_body: Scrybe embeds it directly. Audio goes in, text comes out, nothing is sent remotely.
tech_stat_cost_label: No API bills, No account creation
tech_whisper_body: whisper.cpp is Georgi Gerganov's port of OpenAI's Whisper speech-recognition model to plain C/C++.
